description: This file defines a parser for iMessage notification payloads, including type guards for validating various optional fields within the notification object.

methods.name: function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record object.

methods.name: function isOptionalString(value: unknown): value is string | null | undefined { isOptionalString
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a string or null/undefined.

methods.name: function isOptionalStringOrNumber(value: unknown): value is string | number | null | undefined { isOptionalStringOrNumber
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a string, number, or null/undefined.

methods.name: function isOptionalNumber(value: unknown): value is number | null | undefined { isOptionalNumber
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a number or null/undefined.

methods.name: function isOptionalBoolean(value: unknown): value is boolean | null | undefined { isOptionalBoolean
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a boolean or null/undefined.

methods.name: function isOptionalStringArray(value: unknown): value is string[] | null | undefined { isOptionalStringArray
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value is an array of strings or null/undefined.

methods.name: function isOptionalAttachments(value: unknown): value is IMessagePayload["attachments"] { isOptionalAttachments
methods.description: Type guard to validate the optional attachments array within the message payload.

methods.name: export function parseIMessageNotification(raw: unknown): IMessagePayload | null { parseIMessageNotification
methods.description: Main function to parse and validate a raw notification object into an IMessagePayload or null.

ctags.name: isOptionalBoolean
ctags.pattern: /^function isOptionalBoolean(value: unknown): value is boolean | null | undefined {$/

ctags.name: isOptionalNumber
ctags.pattern: /^function isOptionalNumber(value: unknown): value is number | null | undefined {$/

ctags.name: isOptionalString
ctags.pattern: /^function isOptionalString(value: unknown): value is string | null | undefined {$/

ctags.name: isOptionalStringArray
ctags.pattern: /^function isOptionalStringArray(value: unknown): value is string[] | null | undefined {$/

ctags.name: isOptionalStringOrNumber
ctags.pattern: /^function isOptionalStringOrNumber(value: unknown): value is string | number | null | undefined {$/

ctags.name: isRecord
ctags.pattern: /^function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {$/
